findings.headline: Run blocked at login without scenario auth
findings.rootCause: The run had no scenario bound, so no authenticated session or supporting data was provisioned for a protected settings route. The browser remained on the auth screen and never exercised the Apps & Plugins or Salesforce Managed Package flow. This is a setup/scenario binding gap, not evidence of an app regression.
findings.whatHappened: The browser never reached the Integrations settings page; it stayed on the Nimbus auth screen showing login options. No app errors or broken UI were visible. Baseline is weak because prior_runs reports this test has never passed or run before.

evidence.detail: Prior-run baseline shows there is no validated passing history for this test.
evidence.snippet: No prior runs recorded for this test - it has NEVER been executed before

evidence.detail: Provisioning did not bind or seed any scenario/auth for this protected route.
evidence.snippet: status=no_scenario - No scenario was bound to this run - no auth or data was seeded.

evidence.detail: Video showed the browser stuck on the Nimbus authentication screen instead of reaching Integrations settings.
